opening.argument: The video presents a concrete, step-by-step method for obtaining ordinary retail savings: viewers are shown how to use Target Cartwheel online, with pickup or drive-up required, and the checkout summaries visibly show the discount being applied. The demonstration reports a $20 reduction on a karaoke-machine order and a $22.25 total reduction comprising 25% off the karaoke machine and 30% off the coffee. The separate Fetch referral offer is not connected to this Cartwheel demonstration. Nothing in the available evidence establishes the value or fulfillment of the points, so it does not change the straightforward character of the demonstrated retail promotion.
